notes: Every case must pass before any UI work. 'input' fields map to update(); 'next_loads' are displayed loads at 80/85/90% of the resulting TM after rounding (nearest 2.5, ties down). v1.1: out-of-scope blocks removed (trap_bar_jump, cmj, flare_ladder, gap); accessory slot ids now match the config; cases added for the phase 1 rulings and for manual overrides. v1.2: ramp, ladder and day-selection cases added for phase 3; golden log is now r4; file names corrected. v1.3: explosive (A.24) and rounds (A.25) blocks added. v1.4 (9 Oct 2026): every v1.3 block unchanged; adds `skip` (A.26) and `amend` (A.28). Base for both blocks is initial_state_v1_1.json. Steps are AnyLog objects passed to update(); a correction is a list of actions passed to amend(). Expected values are hand-computed from §2 and §3. v1.5 (10 Oct 2026): every v1.4 block unchanged except `session.ladder`. Under programme_config_v1_5.json the ladder schedule is empty (one 51 cm box, no ladder; ui_spec_v1_3.md §13A test 19), so the cases that expected rsi_ladder now expect the template's normal reactive items: 21 Sep Day 1 holds depth_jump with 6 contacts, and 9 Nov Day 1 holds depth_jump and depth_landing. `golden_sessions` stays pinned to programme_config_v1_3.json, the config in force on 21 Sep. v1.6 (19 Oct 2026): every v1.5 block unchanged. `pinned` names the config each template-dependent block is read against: golden_sessions against programme_config_v1_3.json, session.ladder and rounds against programme_config_v1_5.json (the M2 contrast rounds they describe are gone from v1.6), every other block against programme_config_v1_6.json. Adds `swap` (A.32), `rep_override` (A.33), `first_load`, `audit_trims` (A.34), `phase_tests` (A.35), `record_only` (A.29, A.35, A.36), `templates` and `removed_slots`. Base for every new block is initial_state_v1_1.json; a `state_patch` is deep-merged into it. Expected values are hand-computed from the rules. v1.10 (12 Nov 2026): every v1.9 block unchanged except `templates` and `audit_trims`, whose main-lift items now read the heavy doubles of programme_config_v1_10.json (mode heavy_doubles; 3 doubles in Block 2 with no range, 2 in Blocks 3 and 4, 1 in the taper). `pinned.default` moves to programme_config_v1_10.json. Adds `heavy_doubles` (A.43: what is prescribed, and what the last double does to the training max) and `single_rir` (A.44: a test single read by its reps left). In both, `logs` are AnyLog objects passed to update() in order from the patched initial state; `expect.tm` is the lift's unrounded training max after the last log, to tolerance.tm. Expected values are hand-computed from A.43 and A.44.
